title: TiangongKaiwu release manifest v1
description: Schema for scripts/release-manifest.mjs (G1 J3.1). This describes a release manifest only; it is not the release gate. Digests accept canonical 'sha256:<64 hex>' or bare 64-hex form; the tool normalizes to the canonical form when building. The optional evidence[] array references local SBOM/signature/attestation/provenance files; release policy (--require-release-evidence) requires at least one sbom, one signature or attestation, and one provenance entry, while local/CI structural fixtures remain policy-free.

tag.description: Release tag (for example backend-20261122). 'latest' is not a deployable tag.

sourceCommit.description: Full git commit: 40 hex (SHA-1) or 64 hex (SHA-256).

name.description: Image reference without digest (for example ghcr.io/chenjinxian/luban-web-public). A ':latest' tag is rejected.

images.description: Published image digests. Names must be unique (enforced by the tool).

sbomDigest.description: Legacy single SBOM digest (format-only). It is kept for backward compatibility but does not satisfy the release evidence policy because no local file bytes can be re-hashed; use evidence[] with kind "sbom" for release manifests.

path.description: Repository-relative or absolute path to the native provenance file.

nativeProvenance.description: Optional in the schema; required by release policy (--require-native-provenance) whenever the release ships backend/native artifacts. verify-files re-hashes the actual file bytes.

artifacts.description: Release artifacts whose SHA-256 is verified against actual local file bytes by `verify-files`. Image digests are registry-side and are not covered here.

path.description: Repository-relative (resolved against --root) or absolute path to the artifact.

evidence.description: Local release evidence files (SBOM, signature, attestation, provenance). `verify-files` re-hashes every entry. Release policy (--require-release-evidence) requires at least one sbom entry, at least one signature or attestation entry, and at least one provenance entry. This proves only that the declared local files exist and match their SHA-256; cryptographic signature verification, SBOM format validation, and image-to-evidence binding remain external release-environment duties.

kind.description: Evidence class. sbom = SBOM file; signature = image/artifact signature bundle; attestation = signed attestation bundle; provenance = build provenance statement. The tool does not parse or cryptographically verify these files.

path.description: Repository-relative (resolved against --root) or absolute path to the evidence file.
